mapper.insert: insert into goods_sku (goods_id, parent_id, sku_name, goods_money, sales, inventory, attr_name) values (#{goodsId}, #{parentId}, #{skuName}, #{goodsMoney}, #{sales}, #{inventory}, #{attrName})
mapper.select:
SELECT gs.id, gs.goods_id, gs.sku_img, gs.sku_original_price, gs.sku_price, gs.stock, gs.sales, gsi.detail_json, gsi.language_type, gsi.language_name FROM goods_sku AS gs LEFT JOIN goods_sku_i18n AS gsi ON gs.id = gsi.sku_id where gs.goods_id = #{goodsId}
and gsi.language_type = #{languageType}
